image_pattern_summary: Verified good images for Modular Buildings show completed or near-completed prefabricated structures photographed from an exterior angle that reveals the full building facade, panel construction, window and door configuration, and installed context. Buildings appear in real-world settings — construction sites, industrial compounds, residential rooftops, or car parks — in natural daylight. The most informative images show the building's structural system (steel frame, sandwich panels, cladding type) and scale clearly from a three-quarter perspective.

reason: Modular building images show exterior facades where no meaningful text is printed on the product surface itself.
Product identity (panel type, construction method, scale, application) is communicated visually through form, colour, cladding, and installed context.
OCR cannot extract useful specification data from building exterior photographs — all buyer-relevant information must come from title, specs, and description fields.
